claim_supported: Transformer architecture is a major predecessor capability for modern LLM systems.
title: Attention Is All You Need
limitations: Does not establish present-day agentic performance or enterprise suitability.

claim_supported: Large-scale autoregressive pretraining demonstrated broad task adaptation through prompting/few-shot examples, with uneven results.
title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
limitations: Does not establish reliable domain judgment or current model performance.

claim_supported: Retrieval-augmented generation combined parametric generation with retrieved external information.
title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
limitations: Does not establish retrieved information is always correct, current or applicable.

claim_supported: Instruction tuning and human-feedback reinforcement improved instruction following while residual errors remained.
title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
limitations: Improved instruction following does not establish factual correctness or organizational authority.

claim_supported: Reasoning-and-action prompting demonstrated interleaving model-generated reasoning with actions and observations in evaluated tasks.
title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
limitations: Does not establish reliable autonomous organizational decision-making.

claim_supported: Language models can be trained to decide when and how to invoke external tools/APIs.
title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
limitations: Tool use does not establish permission, correct tool selection or safe organizational authority.
